title: VTC Directory — Export — payload
description: A directory administrator exports the whole member directory as JSContact cards, a page at a time. Members cannot export. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

format.description: The export format. Only JSContact (RFC 9553) in this version.

reason.description: Why, recorded with the change and shown to anyone who must approve it.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller and this export; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 500; the responder chooses a default (200) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTC Directory — Export — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/directory/export/0.2 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/directory/export/0.2#response.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
